title: Bluetooth Mini Bug
subtitle: Upcycled Bluetooth Audio Monitoring Device
shortDescription: A compact Bluetooth audio monitoring device built from a salvaged neckband module. This project demonstrates how discarded Bluetooth neckbands can be repurposed into a functional miniature audio monitoring device for educational purposes.
fullDescription: The Bluetooth Mini Bug project was initiated to demonstrate the repurposing of electronic waste into functional devices. A discarded neckband module with an integrated microphone was salvaged and reconfigured into a compact audio monitoring device. The module was powered by its original battery, and the microphone was utilized to capture ambient audio. The device operates by pairing with a smartphone via Bluetooth, allowing the user to listen to live audio from the device's location within a range of 5-10 meters. The project focuses solely on demonstrating the technical feasibility of repurposing waste electronics and is intended strictly for educational and research purposes. The creator does not endorse or take responsibility for any misuse of this technology. The project also paves the way for future development of a universal application that could transform any Bluetooth headset or earphone into a similar monitoring device.
problemStatement: Electronic waste, including discarded Bluetooth devices, is growing rapidly. Many functional components from these devices, such as microphones and Bluetooth modules, remain usable but are often discarded. There is a lack of awareness about how to repurpose these components into functional devices. Additionally, there is no accessible solution for converting old Bluetooth neckbands into simple audio monitoring tools for educational purposes. This project aims to demonstrate the potential of e-waste repurposing by building a functional device from discarded components.
solution: This project repurposes a discarded neckband module by utilizing its built-in microphone and Bluetooth capabilities. The module is powered using its original battery, and its audio output is paired with a smartphone. The device functions as a miniature audio monitoring tool, transmitting live audio from its location to the paired smartphone within a 5-10 meter range. The device is compact and lightweight, making it easy to deploy in various educational or research scenarios. A future application is envisioned that will enable users to easily connect and control any Bluetooth headset or earphone with a microphone for similar purposes.
